description.value: Mr. Shawarma claims to be the first Middle Eastern and shawarma food truck in Canada, serving Vancouver since 2009. Their 800 Robson Street spot is their main location among several downtown Vancouver outposts, all offering halal-certified chicken shawarma, beef steak shawarma, and freshly made falafel wraps prepared daily from scratch. The takeout-focused, meals-on-the-go format is well suited to cyclists fuelling up in the heart of the city.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, active operation with a main fixed location at 800 Robson Street (corroborating the OSM address) and multiple other downtown Vancouver locations. The contact page provides a phone number absent from OSM. The website is strongly takeout/on-the-go focused, and the menu clearly includes falafel as a vegetarian option. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website contact page lists (604) 569-1644 — recommend adding to OSM.

OSM tags street_vendor=food_truck, but the website describes 800 Robson Street as the 'Main Location' and lists three additional fixed street locations; it is unclear whether this is a permanent kiosk or a parked truck.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible fast-food business at a confirmed downtown Vancouver address with an operating website and online ordering. Useful to touring cyclists as a quick halal meal stop.
